title: Iron Rain
summary: Start: enter Iron Rain. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The ambush holds until a keel crosses that line. A kite keeps the flank. The nickel stream is a barn's living and a fighter's grave. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Anvil Heaven's shell. A drift rumor. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
